notes.title: Major version overhaul
notes.notes:
Major Update for Stardust Origins
Commanders, it’s been a while! And we’re back with the biggest update since launch.
The galaxy just got sharper, smoother, and louder.


The headline featureFull support for modern HDMI displays: 2K, 4K, and even 8K screens now scale beautifully thanks to our brand-new UI scaling system. Whether you’re playing on a laptop or a giant TV, your cockpit now looks crystal-clear.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/6d9450c16060ecaecac28461bc3b6a676434c71d.png"]

But that’s not all. This update also brings a long list of fixes, improvements, and optimizations to make your adventures in Stardust Origins better than ever.


Highlights
Scalable UI - adapts to your resolution and in-game settings

Crisper soundscape - dozens of missing effects restored (explosions, weapons, hyper jump, mission actions, UI sounds)

Smarter enemies - NPCs no longer fire at you after death (they’ve finally learned some respect 👾)

Better missions - fixes to duplicate mission triggers and death-while-landing exploits

Contraband system improved - get caught, and your goods are confiscated… unless you’ve got the credits to bribe your way out

Performance optimizations - reduced memory usage for smoother gameplay


Why This Matters
This isn’t just bug-fixing. It’s about making Stardust Origins ready for today’s screens and playstyles, while keeping the charm and challenge intact. We know many of you have been waiting for these fixes, thank you for your patience!


[hr][/hr]
Let us know what you think of the new update, and as always - fly safe, pilot!
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Small patch to fix a problem when loading a game
notes.notes:
One user reported a bug to me, that when loading a saved game, everything crashes. And by sending in a bug report using the built-in bug report system, I was able to track down the culprit and hopefully fix it. The reason I write hopefully is because I wasn't able to reproduce it myself.

Even so, I added some more lines to the logfile, which will help identify the exact location of the problem, if there still is one :-)

notes.title: Game updated to version 1.10
notes.notes: I have updated the game files with a small bug fix for the ship name in the mission where you need to deliver 20 pearls. The ship name kept getting added to itself, making it larger and larger. This has now been fixed :-)

notes.title: Small update to v1.01
notes.notes:
The first update for Stardust
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/8208de58d2ff357f0bfa41eedf351336537008dd.png
I have added a new option in the Options-screen. Enable mouse shooting. If this is turned off, the ships laser wont fire when you press the mouse button. Convenient to reduce the number of fines given on a starport for shooting in the safe zone.

I also fixed a rare bug, that could occur when you take off from a space station.

notes.title: Release date has settled
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/51a0b11a664fdcdc1caf333dc9c3ee6cafc0295f.png
Development of Stardust Origins has come so far, that I am confident in saying that the release date will be february 2, 2022.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: DEMO has been updated with bug fixes
notes.notes:
You guys have been so nice sending in bug reports when you have encountered them. Thank you so much! It really helps quality ensure my game. 

Since all NPC's in the game do their own things in their own pace, it can be difficult to test every corner case, so your bug reporting really help so much! 

Thank you!

I've updated the demo to version to 0.78 which includes bug fixes to the most common encountered bugs you have reported. I hope you will update the game, and give it another spin :)

notes.title: DEMO updated to version 0.76 in preparation for Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
I'm excited for being part of the Steam Next Fest which starts october 1. But this has also put some stress and anxiety on me, as I really want my game to be polished and really playable without bugs or annoyances.

Here's a list of what I've been up to, on the game:


 Added new compartment: Laser extender - Extend the length of your current laser
 Fixed a bug in the pearl collecting mission
 Fixes regarding the story missions and progressing
 Fixes regarding lights not dissapearing
 Added tutorials to the first mission and to the pearl collecting mission
 Added compartment : Chaff - Defensive measure to lure missiles away
 Added more malfunctioning compartments, if not serviced properly
 Fixed bug in passenger mission
 Fixed bug in share totals
 Added more music and sound effects
 Begun working on achievements
 Changed the way mining crew gets paid. No longer automatic, you have to do it in the mining report
 Added space snakes to all void areas
 Added new goods item : snake skins - Very rare and very expensive. You might get a skin, when you kill a snake
 Changed the way prices are calculated on stations
 Fixed black graphics on some planets


I will be ready and looking for feedback and bug reports the entire week, while you are playing the demo.

notes.title: DEMO updated to version 0.74
notes.notes:
I have just uploaded a new version 0.74 of the DEMO for Stardust Origins - Go grab it right away! :)

What have changed:

 The entire code for handling hull space and compartments have been rewritten to give more options and add flexibility
 Added missiles to some police ships
 Added E.C.M to kill incoming missiles
 Attached E.C.M on certain NPC's
 Added Plasma array to kill incoming missiles and cripple nearby ships
 Added a top mounted gun you can attach to your ship. 
 Updated tutorials when starting a new game
 Added ingame cursor, instead of the system one
 Added pause option when in stations
 Fixed missiles hit - They were sometimes off

notes.title: DEMO updated to version 0.71
notes.notes:
I have had some good feedback from the demo (thank you to you all!) and have prioritized adding some of the requested items plus fixed a number of bugs (a few game breaking). 


 Fixed timeout on mission 1
 Fixed bug regarding updating reputation
 Changed reputation factor on non-goverend planets
 Added more graphics to some planets
 Added more tutorials for new starters of the game
 Added a lot more sound effects
 Added new parcel delivery missions
 Added a star on planet and star map indicating where missions occur
 Added a mine on planet and star map to indicate where you have mines
 Added NPC hunter for some parcel delivery missions
 Fixed bug with black laser
 Fixed a bug with selected rectangle on ships
 Updated tutorials for when in a station
 Fixed a bug where the quick command wheel wasn't initialized
 Added a previous seen date for wanted ships
 Added ranks to player. Rank is updated according to number of wanted kills
 Added more random tips in the main menu


If you haven't already, you should really give the demo a try and let me know what you think of it. I know it's still a work-in-progress, but it is very much playable and good for a few hours of gameplay.

notes.title: Still working on the new version
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/a6d8d36636aaf0d6192d080ca71acbc69721fcaf.gif

Work is still going as planned and with more work hours than initially anticipated. This I really like! 

So far I've been working the following areas:


 Hyperjumping from planet to planet
 New area, the asteroid fields - Here you will be able to mine minerals
 Market prices for all stations has been implemented. Prices will change according to supply and demand and the planets needs for certain comodities
 All selectable objects on a planet can be selected and communicated with (still ongoing)
 Planet map with all selectable objects shown
 Tutorials have been added to some functions and more will come
 New general dialog layout


Next big step is to implement the different NPC's. I will be starting out with the Freighter-type, as this one hauls cargo from planet to planet and thereby influences the prices on the stations.

I will keep you posted! And please dont hesitate to comment to these post either directly here or in the community.
